description: The minimum defining u is attained and lies below every nonprincipal ultrafilter base size.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SmallFamilies.ultrafilterNumber_spec :

      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SmallFamilies.IsFreeUltrafilterBase B ∧
        Cardinal.mk ↑B = Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SmallFamilies.ultrafilterNumber) ∧
    ∀ (B : Set (Set ℕ)),
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SmallFamilies.IsFreeUltrafilterBase B →
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SmallFamilies.ultrafilterNumber ≤ Cardinal.mk ↑B
